observed_facts: MakerWorld: five DOF, GC0308 0.3MP, 1.09inch TFT, SCS009 bus servos
Manufacturer Shop: electronics kit USD109, assembled full unit USD124, pre-sale / holiday delay banner
rig_omni and rig_local each contain Arm board and IK / motor source
rig_local: OpenAI-compatible text LLM plus DashScope ASR / TTS, function calls linked to device MCP
rig_local: main/mcp_http_server.cc implements local POST JSON-RPC initialize / tools/list / tools/call
Branch differences: rig_omni teach_stop saves without automatic playback and idle disabled default; rig_local teach_stop automatically replays and idle enabled default
Motor source decodes feedback position / speed / torque and can enable / disable servo torque
rig_omni README_CN claims Apache2.0; no project-level LICENSE file found; rig_local README has no overall licence statement
MakerWorld model SDFL-C restricts redistribution of model / derivative files outside MakerWorld; do not vendor STL files into FYP
Manufacturer reply 2026-09-20: phone is too heavy for Arm; no payload value verified
Official Wiki lists published Hover / Arm driver-board schematic v2026.09.22; old August promise is superseded by current resource index
Official MCP guide offers no-firmware-change device-control configuration and a separate external-tools WebSocket access point, conditional on account / hardware availability
rig_local Arm get_device_status adds IMU fields; direct motion completion / unified stop / watchdog contract not established
rig_omni WebSocket audio hello declares Opus 16k mono; current FYP voice protocol is PCM 16k input / 24k output
rig_local current TTS default streams sentences; this is a cascade, not evidence of native natural full-duplex conversation
Current FYP output CLI supports simulator and pca9685 only; no RIG adapter
still_to_verify: Actual SKU / board / factory firmware and available model-specific tools
Local / official-cloud transport availability and credentials from the owner device account
Physical completion, bounded motion, cancellation, startup and disconnection behaviour
Complete matching BOM / PCB source licence and rig_local overall software licence
Original supply / pack contents / payload / shipping / real API quality and costs
